entry_capture: first eligible market capture at or after the immutable frozen forecast and before kickoff
closing_line_policy: compare with the latest captured market no more than 90 minutes before kickoff when the newest provider update is no more than 180 minutes old
guardrails: No outcome may be selected using the final score or post-match data.
A losing positive-EV selection remains a losing bet.
Best-price returns must never replace median-price returns in the headline.
Promotion decisions require prospective multi-week evidence, not this retrospective exploratory weekend.
